title: LATAM Equity Index
description: Schema for artifacts/latam_equity_index.json — one record per LATAM population, sorted descending by equity_score.

transplants_pmp.description: Kidney transplants per million population (most recent year available)

total_transplants.description: Absolute transplant count for the reported year

data_year.description: Year of the transplant data used

transplants_pmp_is_estimate.description: True only for PRI, which lacks IRODaT data; value is derived from US territory figures

pgx_delta_tacrolimus.description: delta_vs_baseline (pp) for tacrolimus/CYP3A5 vs CEU. Retained for backward compatibility; use pgx_per_gene.CYP3A5 for the composite.

pct_requiring_change.description: Percentage of individuals requiring dose/therapy change for tacrolimus/CYP3A5 per CPIC guidelines

pgx_composite_gap.description: Mean |delta_vs_baseline| across all 5 focal CPIC Level A gene-drug pairs. Equal to pgx_gap.

pgx_per_gene.description: Per-gene absolute delta breakdown: {gene_symbol: abs_delta_pp}. Keys are CYP3A5, CYP2C19, VKORC1, DPYD, CYP2C9.

access_gap.description: Global median pmp minus this country's pmp. Positive = below median (worse access).

pgx_gap.description: Equal to pgx_composite_gap. Named for formula symmetry: equity_score = access_gap + pgx_gap.

equity_score.description: access_gap + pgx_gap. Higher = worse compounded inequity on both dimensions simultaneously.
